observation: Short raw scancode batches changed fields as requested. Longer batches returned zero without entering the full text; the masked password showed only two characters and weak strength. No account was submitted.
interpretation: A guest-input batching limitation is suspected; not established as a general Hyper-V limit.
next_method: Use chunks of at most four ASCII characters (at most sixteen scan bytes), with 500ms between calls. Clear the incomplete fields first and verify strong/matching passwords before submitting.
